about.description:
Cross-platform Python library for hardware-based device fingerprinting,
device binding, and fraud prevention. Includes a pluggable cryptographic
backend architecture (classical HMAC, hybrid-hash, and post-quantum
Dilithium3 signatures), optional TPM 2.0 / Secure Enclave integration,
ML-based behavioral anomaly detection, and encrypted local storage.

Note: the optional post-quantum crypto backend (`pqcdualusb`) and cloud
storage backends (`boto3`, `azure-storage-blob`) are not included as
conda dependencies here since they are optional extras - install them
via pip alongside this package if needed:
  pip install pqcdualusb boto3 azure-storage-blob

name: device-fingerprinting-pro
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "2.3.0"

package:
  name: device-fingerprinting-pro
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/d/device-fingerprinting-pro/device_fingerprinting_pro-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d7f8574a8b8ed39b565355e5c186104167a976611840aef0aad5afeb2e2b321d

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  # This PyPI release is pure Python - the optional pqc_rust PyO3 extension
  # is a separate, not-bundled local build step (via maturin) and is not
  # part of the sdist, so no compiler/cross-compilation setup is required.

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=61.0
    - wheel
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.21.0
    - scikit-learn >=1.0.0
    - psutil >=5.8.0
    - cryptography >=44.0.1
    - keyring >=23.0.0
    - certifi >=2024.7.4

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - device_fingerprinting
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Johnsonajibi/DeviceFingerprinting
  summary: Hardware device fingerprinting with post-quantum cryptography, TPM support, and ML-based anomaly detection
  description: |
    Cross-platform Python library for hardware-based device fingerprinting,
    device binding, and fraud prevention. Includes a pluggable cryptographic
    backend architecture (classical HMAC, hybrid-hash, and post-quantum
    Dilithium3 signatures), optional TPM 2.0 / Secure Enclave integration,
    ML-based behavioral anomaly detection, and encrypted local storage.

    Note: the optional post-quantum crypto backend (`pqcdualusb`) and cloud
    storage backends (`boto3`, `azure-storage-blob`) are not included as
    conda dependencies here since they are optional extras - install them
    via pip alongside this package if needed:
      pip install pqcdualusb boto3 azure-storage-blob
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://device-fingerprinting.readthedocs.io
  repository: https://github.com/Johnsonajibi/DeviceFingerprinting

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Johnsonajibi
